purpose: Teach: ヒデ/オト/ヨハネ/チャールズ/アラン/エホバ/トーマス/ケリー

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがX JAPANのヒデを尊敬されてるわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad has so much respect for Hide from X Japan.
lines.style: Warm, observational tone. Gentle lilt on the opening. Speaking as if sharing something she's noticed and found touching. Soft, unhurried pace.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お友達のオトちゃんと遊んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I played with my friend Oto today!
lines.style: Bright, eager delivery. Quick tempo. Open, unguarded enthusiasm. Slight uplift at the end like he's offering the fact as a gift to share.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが聖書のヨハネ伝を読んで下さってるわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad is reading the Gospel of John from the Bible.
lines.style: Reflective, gentle noticing. Even softer than the first line. Speaking with quiet appreciation, as if remarking on something meaningful. Trailing edge soft.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと英王室のチャールズ国王の写真集見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — Dad and I looked at a photo book of King Charles today!
lines.style: Genuine excitement, no affectation. Quick pace. Small laugh tucked under the delivery. Earnest pride in the shared activity, not performing for effect.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがアラン・チューリングの伝記を読んで下さってるわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad is reading Alan Turing's biography right now.
lines.style: Calm, attentive tone. Slight pause before the name, as if honoring its importance. Measured pacing. The register of someone noticing and valuing what matters.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに「エホバの証人とは」って解説して頂いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — Dad explained what Jehovah's Witnesses are to me!
lines.style: Earnest, slightly awed delivery. Careful on the explanation — treating the topic with seriousness. Forward lean in the voice. Pride in being trusted with grown-up knowledge.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが機関車トーマスのDVDを下さったわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad gave me a Thomas the Tank Engine DVD.
lines.style: Tender warmth. Slower, savoring pace. Gentle emphasis on 「下さった」 — the gift-giving matters. Voice softens at the end. Gratitude without heaviness.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとケリー長官のニュース見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — Dad and I watched the news about Secretary Kerry together!
lines.style: Bright, close, companionable. Quick-paced but not rushed. The intimacy of 'we watched this together.' Small pleased exhale at the end, like checking that she's being heard.
